title: Cashless Insurance Pre-Authorization and Query Resolution

steps.description: Obtain patient government photo ID, health insurance policy card, and signed cashless claim declaration.
Admitting physician completes clinical pre-authorization form with ICD-10 diagnosis code and proposed procedure.
TPA executive uploads pre-auth docket to payer portal within 6 hours of planned admission or 24 hours of emergency admission.
Monitor portal for insurer queries (RFI) regarding past medical history or investigation reports, and respond within 2 hours.
On receipt of initial approval letter, record preauth_amount and change status to 'approved' in HIS.

common_blockers: Pre-existing disease clause exclusions invoked by insurer without clinical substantiation
Delay in obtaining past treatment records or prescription slips from attender
Payer server downtime or API portal integration failure during emergency admissions
